chatTitle: Repurposing a Veshti into a Kovanam
summary:
The user is interested in repurposing an old veshti into several smaller pieces to be used as கோவணம்s. They are experimenting with different dimensions, starting with 10 pieces of about 3" by 2" width. 


The user is familiar with US-style trousers and is using that as a reference point for understanding how to cut the veshti. 


The user is comfortable with experimentation and adjusting the size of the pieces as needed.
